Onboarding · The Draft

Pull your first deck from the vortex

Pay entry, draft twenty cards one per row, and keep every one. A balanced format — a new player's real shot against veterans; your skill, not your collection size — with a genuine chance at rares. Entry: 5,000 ◈ Zenni (the onboarding paywall) · prototype pricing.

Cosmetics · Kinzo

The Kinzo Shop

Spend Kinzo on cosmetic flair — accent auras, card backs, emblems, and duelist titles. Everything here is purely aesthetic and never affects play.

◈5,000Zenni Points
Player Market · Zenni

The Zenni Marketplace

Players list cards from their vault, priced in ◈ Zenni — the card currency, earned in play. Every card carries its full match record; you're buying the history, not just the art. Zenni never cashes out.

◈0 ZenniZenni Balance
⚠ Prototype only — no real charges execute. Cards trade only in Zenni — an in-game currency with no cash value: earned in play, convertible from Kinzo, but never withdrawn or cashed out. This closed loop (value flows in, never out) is what keeps a player market clear of money-transmission and securities rules — get qualified legal counsel before enabling anything beyond it.

Reincarnation · The Saga

Assemble your party

You don't march into the Rift — you pilot it. Choose a Champion: the card you'd follow into anything. You never field it directly — its presence empowers the units that serve you, and at the crest of battle you unleash its Ultimate. Rally 2–3 companions, descend through the Saga, and every victory is written into your Champion's legend.

“You do not enter the Rift alone — you enter it as someone. Choose the card you would follow into the dark, and it becomes your Champion: your banner, your voice, your name. Your units fight for that name. Every Rift you survive, you survive together.”

Staked PvP · High Stakes

Wager Duel — cards on the line

Stake one of your cards against a real rival's. Win the best-of-7 and their card is yours. Lose and yours is forfeited — removed from your collection. No rank staked — just the cards, plus a small Zenni payout for the win. Real card stakes only ever happen against a real matched opponent — never a practice bot.

⚖ Skill-based · no real money in this prototype. Cards you stake are won and lost for keeps — but never for cash. Real-money-stakes wagering would need qualified legal counsel first and is not enabled here.

Online · Live Server

KOTEI Online

Creating an account carries this device's progress with it — your cards, their records and your Zenni are copied up once, and the account becomes the real home for them. Signing in to an account you already have does not upload anything: it loads that account as it stands, and this device's local save is left untouched.

Turn Conditions Each turn, one condition is drawn at random before either player commits a card. The condition is visible to both players simultaneously — the decision is who you think has the better hand for it.
Card Abilities Abilities are what separate a good deck from a great read. They activate at specific timings relative to the condition reveal and card commitment — knowing when to hold versus fire is the skill ceiling.

Instant Abilities — activate from hand or field during either Instant Window, before or after commit

Pre-Commit Abilities — fire after condition reveal, before either player commits

On-Commit Abilities — fire the moment your card enters the field

Resolution Abilities — fire during or after the condition resolves

Living Cards — How They Grow Every card is a permanent record that grows the more you play it. Traits unlock from that record and mastery, then fire only at the right moment. Nothing here is bought — it's earned, and every card starts the same climb.

The three ways a card grows

Two layers — earn it, then activate it

First a card earns a trait by crossing a record or mastery threshold — it then shows, lit, in the card's Living Traits. In a duel the trait only fires if its situation is met (e.g. Scarred only when you're behind); otherwise it sits dormant. Earning unlocks the trait; the moment decides whether it helps.

Every trait — how it's earned & when it fires

Beyond traits

Side Stories Short narrative chapters, told between duels. Each one you complete adds a real, unique variant of an existing card to your Vault — same card, its own name and history.
Expeditions Send a charge to a marked location on the map for a chance at a Common or Uncommon card, or a flat Zenni payout. Charges refill on their own over real time.
Archetype Decklists Nine ready-built, 20-card decklists — one per archetype, curated for identity and curve. "Load & Playtest" drops the full list straight into your Deck Builder; if you don't own every card yet, it flips on Playtest Mode so you (or anyone else) can try the deck exactly as designed before ever cracking a pack. Offline Play only — Ranked/Online is unaffected either way, and Staked PvP still needs a fully-owned deck.
Mastery, Traits & Bonds Every character grows three ways: a Mastery track (win as its champion in Reincarnation · The Saga → cosmetic tiers), Living Traits (permanent stat buffs earned just by fighting with the card — each shows how far it is from unlocking), and Bonds (formed when you deck cards together). Track every character's progress here.
Trade Swap earned cards and Reincarnation units with other collectors. Skins and starters never trade — cash-bought finishes stay bound to you.
Friends Add a friend by handle, see who is online, and send a direct challenge — no match code to share.
Match Arc A match is a best-of-7 duel series. Wager stake doubles each time one player holds majority. The raise-or-retreat decision happens between turns, not mid-turn.
Card DNA — Match Record Every card carries a permanent, immutable match history baked into the card itself. Once a card takes a loss, the Pristine status is gone forever. This is what the Vault is protecting.

How to Play
Best of 7, win 4 — except Ranked, which is best of 3, win 2
1
Draw

Tap to draw and start the turn.

2
Reveal the Condition

A rule that reshapes this duel, shown up top. Read it — it can flip the whole fight.

3
Conjure a Fighter ⚡

Drag a card onto the field (or tap it). You need enough Charge (shown on the card) to conjure it — conjuring spends that Charge. This card does the fighting.

4
Call Supports 📣 (free)

Drag more cards to the rear slots — 2 to start, growing to 3 deep into a long match. Their Called ability fires automatically and boosts your Fighter — no Charge cost.

5
Links 🔗

When a support shares a lore group with your Fighter, the Link fires for bonus power. Tap a link name to see its members.

6
Commit

Lock it in. Both cards reveal and clash — the higher total power wins the duel.

⚡ Charge only regenerates +1 a turn through the 4th duel — then about a third of your current cap each turn after that — against a cap that keeps climbing as the match goes on (3, 4, 5, 6, then +2 per duel). It does not refill to full. Leftover Charge carries over, so play cheap Fighters to bank Charge for bigger plays and Spells later. Conjuring a Fighter spends Charge equal to its cost; supports are free.
Records — every card keeps a permanent Win/Loss record. Winners join your Winners Circle; deck cards together to forge Bonds.
Wager — Raise to grow the stakes, or Fold to concede a duel cheaply.

🛠 Developer — Balance 0 edits
Power edits take effect in your next match and across the app. Cost edits are live instantly, from either tab. The ⚡ Abilities tab additionally edits Called and CARD_RULES behavior — also instantly. (The Edit-table's ability field is display text only.) DM Passive (ongoing effects, always on while this card is Deck Master)/DM Activated (a once-per-match ability you press to use) only apply when this card is set as your Deck Master, and accept either real JSON (applies live) or plain English (gold text — saved as a note for Claude to build, nothing breaks if it's not valid JSON). A greyed-out DM Activated cell means that card's ability runs custom code and isn't editable here, source only. 📍 Locations tab edits conditions the same way — all display fields (name/icon/mechanic/tag/prob/rule/strategy) apply live instantly, the note row under each location is for describing an actual mechanic change in plain English for Claude to build (the real per-location logic is hand-coded, no live JSON editor for it yet). 🗡 Reincarnation tab edits Legend combat directly — bespoke unit HP/ATK/SPD/role/passive apply the moment you hit Apply on that card; move kits (signature/extra/capstone, and the per-Roof kits every other card uses) are raw JSON, since a bespoke input per move field would be a huge surface for a rare edit — invalid JSON shows an error and changes nothing.
